gloss: best in the world; number one in the world

definitions.gloss: best in the world; number one in the world
definitions.explanation: The top rank or highest degree among all countries or people in the world. Used as a noun to describe the top position, or adverbially to mean 'the most in the world.'

examples.japanese: {世界一|せかいいち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to be the best in the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世界一|せかいいち}⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This mountain is the tallest in the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{世界一|せかいいち}{可愛|かわい}い⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: She thinks her child is the cutest in the world.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as both a noun and an adverb. As a noun: {世界一|せかいいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧ (to aim for number one in the world). As an adverb: {世界一|せかいいち}⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧ (the most beautiful in the world). Very common in everyday conversation, sports commentary, and advertising.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世界一|せかいいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧ (to aim to be the best in the world)
- {世界一|せかいいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧ (world record)
- {世界一|せかいいち}{幸|しあわ}せ (the happiest in the world)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日本一|にほんいち}: the best in Japan — same pattern but limited to Japan
- {世界最高|せかいさいこう}: the world's best — a more formal expression
